name: com.lingkyn.live-tuning.core
description: Engine-light live tuning substrate: immutable TunableId and SnapshotId identity with a canonical dotted-segment form, a closed TunableKind set (float, integer, bool, enumerated, colour, vector2, vector3) with fail-closed kind-declaration validation, an immutable TunableRegistry built by explicit registration, tuning intents (set, reset, reset_all, snapshot, apply_snapshot) applied to an immutable override-only TuningState with deterministic replay and a fingerprint, a closed EditorKind set with a total ResolveEditorKind function, engine-free BindingRecord validation, a two-way token bridge to and from a design-language token JSON document, and structured results with stable failure codes.

samples.description: Domain-only walkthrough: a registry built from explicit registration and from the token bridge, a full set/reset/snapshot/apply_snapshot/export intent sequence, and a replayed sequence proving deterministic state; needs no asset, scene, or UnityEngine API.
